The `channel` field cannot be safely removed from [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L26) or the [`Order`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/orders-service/src/core/order.ts#L16-L29) model because **`analytics-ingest` still strictly requires it**.

### Downstream Contract Dependency

Checking the downstream consumer repository [analytics-ingest](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/analytics-ingest):

1. **Strict Contract Check**:
   In [analytics-ingest/src/core/events.ts](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/analytics-ingest/src/core/events.ts#L36), incoming [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L26) events are validated with:
   ```ts
   const channel = reader.oneOf("channel", CHANNELS);
   ```
   If `channel` is missing or undefined, ingestion immediately throws [`ContractViolationError`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/analytics-ingest/src/core/errors.ts#L4) (tested in [analytics-ingest/test/ingest.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/analytics-ingest/test/ingest.test.ts#L43-L45)).

2. **Lake Persistence**:
   In [analytics-ingest/src/ingest.ts](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/analytics-ingest/src/ingest.ts#L12) and [analytics-ingest/src/core/rows.ts](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/analytics-ingest/src/core/rows.ts#L5), `channel` is written directly into the `orders` data lake table (`order_id, placed_date, channel, currency, units`).

3. **Documented Contract**:
   [analytics-ingest/README.md](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/analytics-ingest/README.md#L26-L32) explicitly specifies:
   > - `OrderPlaced`: `orderId`, `placedAt` (ISO-8601 datetime), `channel` (`web|store|marketplace`), `currency`, `lines[].sku`, `lines[].qty`...
   > A missing or mistyped field, an unknown `channel` or an unparseable date makes ingestion reject with `ContractViolationError`; nothing is written.

### Impact

Removing `channel` from [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L26) will break the event contract, causing `analytics-ingest` to reject all order events and halt data lake ingestion.

### Recommended Next Steps

Before removing `channel` from [orders-service](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/orders-service):
1. Update `analytics-ingest` (team Data) to make `channel` optional or stop reading it.
2. Deploy the `analytics-ingest` update.
3. Once downstream services no longer read `channel`, remove it from [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L26) and [`Order`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/orders-service/src/core/order.ts#L16-L29).
